annotations.title: Plan a whole trip with Trip720

description: For a request to plan a trip with a budget. Plans a whole trip, home to home, against the traveller's total budget: flights, stays, transfers, activities, visas and daily costs. Returns up to six options, each with a Safe Trip Total (the whole trip with a contingency), the route, and every price labelled live (checked with the provider), estimate (Trip720's own, protection margin included) or official (a government fee), with a link to the option on trip720.travel where it is booked. Side effect: the trip is saved on Trip720 (kept 30 days) so it can be opened and booked; nothing is booked or paid. Limits: at most 6 travellers, 60 nights and 5 named places; flight fares are estimates in this quick build. A trip still being built comes back with status 'building' and its trip id.

amount.description: Total for everyone, home to home, in the currency's main unit (9000 = 9,000 dollars).

towns.description: Towns to include; empty lets Trip720 choose within the country.

destination.description: 'surprise' to let Trip720 choose, or up to 5 places.

interests.description: Finer interests in words, e.g. 'street art', 'hiking'.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the home town, e.g. 'AU'.

pace.description: PACKED: see as much as possible; RELAXED: take it slowly; SETTLED: one place.

returnDate.description: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 60 nights later.

passport.description: Two-letter passport country, for visa rules. The home country when not given.
